title: Infrastructure As a System – Student Competition
description: Design resilient infrastructure projects in the InfraVision 2026 student competition, judged by an international expert jury.
descriptionDetailed: InfraVision's 2026 student competition invites teams of 1 to 6 students to design a resilient, adaptive infrastructure project for uncertain futures. Students from architecture, urban planning, and engineering get feedback from a jury led by architect Sadie Morgan. Prizes total €15,000, with results at Paris InfraWeek in November 2026.

prize.description: 1st prize €7,000, 2nd prize €5,000, 3rd prize €3,000. Results are announced during Paris InfraWeek in November 2026.

audience.eligibilityDetail: Open to students from architecture, urban planning, engineering, economics, public policy, computer science, and related fields. Team members must have active student status during the 2025-2026 academic year; PhD candidates are eligible.
